To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

complex IT outsourcing arrangements pose security and compliance challenges that are currently and will be perceived as relevant by all relevant stakeholders, that these challenges are expected to affect organizational performance adversely in absence of proper responses, and that responses in form of organizational rather than technical measures are perceived as more promising in the case of all security and compliance challenges, except localizing and migra- ting data, for which technical responses are perceived as more prom- ising.
the investigated challenges are perceived as relevant by the stakeholders, affect organizational performance adversely, and are best addressed by organizational responses.
the investigated six challenges are perceived as relevant and affect organizational performance adversely, yet can be addressed by organizational measures and technical measures, respectively.

the question of whether complex IT outsourcing arrangements are feasible in the foreseeable future and what it takes to make them feasible.
the security and compliance aspects of complex IT outsourcing arrangements and their implications on organizational performance

the security and compliance management in the context of complex IT outsourcing arrangements and aims at providing insights on the challenges associated with this topic as well as promising avenues toward their resolution

the security and compliance management in IT outsourcing arrangements is a complex and challenging task, which requires a multi-stakeholder effort to overcome the investigated security and compliance challenges in the near future.
the investigated security and compliance challenges are relevant for the success of complex IT outsourcing arrangements.
the challenges are not yet fully resolved.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the challenges are real and need to be addressed by organizations.
the investigated challenges are perceived as being relevant by multiple stakeholders, that they are likely to remain so in the future, and that they affect organizational performance adversely.

security and compliance challenges associated with complex IT out-sourcing arrangements have been identified, their impact on organizational performance has been confirmed and potential responses have been discussed.

security and compliance challenges in IT outsourcing arrangements can only be overcome by taking into account the perspectives of the involved parties.
the challenges of security and compliance management in complex IT outsourcing environments can be overcome by means of a multi-stakeholder approach.
complex IT outsourcing arrangements promise to provide numerous benefits to organizations, yet they also come with several challenges.
